definition: A comprehensive cloud platform provided by Amazon offering compute, storage and managed networking services globally.
Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud: secure and resizable virtual compute capacity in the cloud.
Amazon Simple Storage Service: highly scalable object storage built to retrieve any amount of data anywhere.
Amazon Virtual Private Cloud: a logically isolated virtual network dedicated to your cloud resources.
Software as a Service: complete software applications delivered over the internet directly to end users.
Platform as a Service: hardware and application frameworks provided for developers to build and run software.
Infrastructure as a Service: on-demand access to fundamental compute, network and storage resources.
Customer relationship management: software designed to manage customer interactions, workflows and business operations.
Network Operations Center: a centralized location where IT technicians supervise, monitor and maintain telecommunications networks.
Corporate social responsibility: initiatives through which companies integrate social and environmental concerns into business operations.
